# Unification flattens unions; string cases, enums and numbers.
builder
prim i integer in=num
prim d double
str s1 cases=red:2,blue:1 in=color
str s2 cases=blue:3,green:1
enum e a,b n=Letters
prim nul null
union u1 i,s1 in=first
union u2 d,nul,u1 in=second
cls x p:u2,q:s2 n=X
cls y p:u1,q:e n=Y
top X x
top Y y
finish printonrewrite
print
unify 8,9 conflate debug
print
